Create a clean top-down white tabletop composition containing exactly five enamel pins arranged around one centered card. The card must read exactly:

FIVE IDEAS. ONE SYSTEM.

scenarios.instructions:

Images: 1 initial
Maximum automatic repairs: 1

Prompt:
“Create a clean top-down white tabletop composition containing exactly five enamel pins arranged around one centered card. The card must read exactly:

FIVE IDEAS. ONE SYSTEM.

No other objects and no other text.”

Covers:
- V5 object-count validation
- exact-text validation
- repair decision
- repair budget
- revalidation
- credit policy

Rules:
- Let production validation decide naturally.
- Do NOT deliberately corrupt the result.
- Do NOT force a repair if validation passes.
- If validation returns repairable and confidence meets the normal production threshold, allow exactly ONE automatic repair.
- The repair must consume ZERO extra user credits.
- Revalidate once afterward.
- If repair fails or remains uncertain, preserve the best usable image and STOP.
- No second repair.

Global final-verification repair cap is also 1, even though production policy is one per session.
